section.title: Package managers and build output
section.intro: Language caches, dependencies and build folders.

rules.title: JavaScript dependencies
rules.whatItIs: Libraries a JavaScript project installed.
rules.consequence: You will need to run the install again, with network access, and any local patches are lost.
rules.sideCondition: Offered because a lockfile sits next to it.

rules.title: JavaScript dependencies without a lockfile
rules.whatItIs: Libraries a JavaScript project installed, with no lockfile beside them.
rules.consequence: Without a lockfile the same versions may not come back, and local patches are lost.

rules.title: Yarn committed cache
rules.whatItIs: A Yarn cache that some projects keep in version control as their dependency source.
rules.consequence: The project may be unable to install its dependencies.

rules.title: npm download cache
rules.whatItIs: Packages npm downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: npm will download them again when needed.

rules.title: pnpm package store
rules.whatItIs: The shared store that pnpm links project dependencies from.
rules.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again when needed.
rules.sideCondition: Use the command, which removes only unreferenced packages. Do not delete by hand.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.whatItIs: Python packages pip downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: pip will download or rebuild them when needed.

rules.title: uv cache
rules.whatItIs: Python packages uv downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: uv will download or rebuild them when needed.
rules.sideCondition: Do not touch it while uv is running.

rules.title: conda packages
rules.whatItIs: Package files shared by your conda environments.
rules.consequence: Only unused packages should be removed, and conda will download them again if needed.
rules.sideCondition: Use the command, never delete by hand.

rules.title: conda environments
rules.whatItIs: Python environments you created.
rules.consequence: You would lose the environment and its installed packages.

rules.title: Cargo downloads
rules.whatItIs: Rust libraries Cargo downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: Cargo will download them again, which needs the network.

rules.title: Cargo tools and settings
rules.whatItIs: Rust tools you installed, your registry login and your settings.
rules.consequence: You would lose installed tools and have to log in and configure Cargo again.

rules.title: Rust build output
rules.whatItIs: Files produced by building a Rust project.
rules.consequence: The project will rebuild in full next time.

rules.title: Gradle downloads
rules.whatItIs: Libraries and tools Gradle downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: Gradle will download them again and the next build will be slower.
rules.sideCondition: Not while a Gradle daemon is running.

rules.title: Gradle settings
rules.whatItIs: Gradle settings you wrote.
rules.consequence: You would lose your own configuration.

rules.title: Maven repository
rules.whatItIs: Libraries Maven downloaded, plus any you installed locally.
rules.consequence: Downloaded libraries come back from the network, but ones installed only on this Mac are lost.

rules.title: Maven settings
rules.whatItIs: Maven settings and credentials.
rules.consequence: You would lose your own configuration.

rules.title: Go modules
rules.whatItIs: Go libraries downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: Go will download them again.
rules.sideCondition: These files are read-only, so use the command.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.whatItIs: Compiled Go packages kept to speed up builds.
rules.consequence: The next builds will be slower.

rules.title: Go tools and sources
rules.whatItIs: Go tools you installed and sources you keep.
rules.consequence: You would lose installed tools or your own code.

rules.title: CocoaPods data
rules.whatItIs: Pod specifications and downloaded pods.
rules.consequence: CocoaPods will download them again, which is large.
rules.sideCondition: Check that no project keeps its Pods folder only here.

rules.title: Swift package cache
rules.whatItIs: Swift packages downloaded earlier.
rules.consequence: They will be fetched again.

rules.title: Swift build output
rules.whatItIs: Files produced by building a Swift package.
rules.consequence: The package will rebuild in full next time.

rules.title: Swift package trust data
rules.whatItIs: Records of packages you chose to trust.
rules.consequence: You would lose those trust decisions.

rules.title: Homebrew installed software
rules.whatItIs: The software Homebrew installed.
rules.consequence: Deleting it removes the apps and tools themselves.
rules.sideCondition: Not offered. The cleanup command removes only outdated versions.
